description: Returns the account, its workspace and its money. `billing.balance` is US dollars and `creditsLeft` the same amount in credits (1,000,000 credits = $1); `goodStanding` false means streams cannot start until credits are added. `spend` is the burn rate now and `running` each stream that is on air now, with its cost so far. `rates` is the price per quality and frame rate, in credits per minute.
name: account_get
title: Get account
